Financial Controller
Finance | London | Hybrid

Department: Finance
Location: London, UK
Work arrangement: Hybrid - 3 days in the office
Employment type: Full-time
Remuneration: £90k-£105k plus annual bonus

Reporting to the CFO, you will lead a team of six and own the monthly close, statutory accounts and
audit for a group of four entities.

Skills and experience
- Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA)
- Experience of a multi-entity group close under UK GAAP
- Confident with NetSuite or a comparable ERP
- Able to partner with non-finance leaders
